rows.commentary: 0.3: Tahir Zaman drops it short, and Walter swiftly guides it towards point for a single.
0.4: Dot ball from Tahir Zaman to Moeen Ali.
0.5: Tahir Zaman pushes through a fuller delivery, turned by Moeen Ali down to deep square leg for one.
0.6: Tahir Zaman floats it up and Walter launches it majestically over long-on for a massive maximum.
1.1: Moeen Ali does not score off Mohammad Amir.
1.2: Mohammad Amir strays slightly, and Moeen Ali deftly guides it away toward third man for a boundary.
1.3: A leg bye off Mohammad Amir's delivery to Moeen Ali.
1.4: No run for Walter off Mohammad Amir.
1.5: Mohammad Amir attacks the stumps, flicked away neatly by Walter into the mid-wicket pocket for a single.
1.6: Moeen Ali does not score off Mohammad Amir.
2.1: Sunil Narine delivers a flat one that Walter steers past the fielder down to third man for four runs.
2.2: Sunil Narine crashes through the defense, shattering the timber to send Walter packing for thirteen.
2.3: Sam Billings does not score off Sunil Narine.
2.4: Sunil Narine slides one into the pads, turned smoothly by Sam Billings towards square leg for a single.
2.5: No run for Moeen Ali off Sunil Narine.
2.6: Sunil Narine keeps it tight, allowing Moeen Ali to tap it across to deep backward point for one more.
9.1: Dot ball from Romario Shepherd to Quentin Sampson.
9.2: Romario Shepherd drops it short, allowing Quentin Sampson to punch a couple of runs toward deep backward point.
9.3: Romario Shepherd floats this into the pads, nudged away by Quentin Sampson into the backward square leg region for two more.
9.4: A bye off Romario Shepherd's delivery to Quentin Sampson.
9.5: Romario Shepherd misses his length, and Liam Livingstone launches it cleanly square of the wicket for a towering maximum.
9.6: Livingstone pushes for the second, but a razor-sharp relay from Khushdil to Azam catches him short of his ground, ending a brisk cameo.
0.1: Andre Fletcher does not score off Richard Gleeson.
0.2: Andre Fletcher does not score off Richard Gleeson.
0.3: Richard Gleeson angles it in, guiding Andre Fletcher to glance a single down toward third man.
0.4: Richard Gleeson pitches it up, allowing Azam Khan to work it through the gap toward deep mid-wicket for a brace.
0.5: Dot ball from Richard Gleeson to Azam Khan.
0.6: Richard Gleeson strays slightly, and Azam Khan punishes him with a colossal six soaring toward deep backward point.
1.1: Andre Fletcher does not score off Alzarri Joseph.
1.2: Dot ball from Alzarri Joseph to Andre Fletcher.
1.3: Alzarri Joseph hits a tight length, gently defended by Andre Fletcher for a brisk single out to cover.
1.4: Alzarri Joseph offers width, and Azam Khan capitalizes instantly by carving it away to the deep backward point boundary.
7.1: Muhammad Arfan drops it short to Kieron Pollard, who nudges it down to long-off for a single.
7.2: Muhammad Arfan claims the prized scalp of Azam Khan as Andre Russell safely pouches the catch in the outfield, ending a blistering 59 off 27 deliveries containing five fours and four sixes.
7.3: Muhammad Arfan feeds Shadab Khan, who works it away cleanly toward deep square leg to pick up one run.
7.4: Dot ball from Muhammad Arfan to Kieron Pollard.
7.5: Muhammad Arfan delivers to Kieron Pollard, who simply pushes the ball down towards long-off to rotate the strike.
7.6: Muhammad Arfan is punished as Shadab Khan launches it brilliantly over backward square leg for a maximum.
8.1: Andre Russell steams in and sees Kieron Pollard drill the ball straight down the ground for a single.
8.2: Shadab Khan does not score off Andre Russell.
8.3: Andre Russell strikes as Shadab Khan holes out, safely caught by Muhammad Arfan after making 7 runs from 4 balls with one six.
8.4: Andre Russell bowls to Khushdil Shah, who collects a single out in the deep mid-wicket region.
8.5: Andre Russell pitches it up and Kieron Pollard launches it majestically over long-off for a huge six.
8.6: Andre Russell strays again, allowing Kieron Pollard to power another shot toward long-off, this time racing away to the boundary for four.
9.1: Muhammad Arfan comes back into the attack and watches Khushdil Shah work the ball down to long-off for one.
9.2: Muhammad Arfan fires it in, and Kieron Pollard works it square of the wicket to scamper back for a couple of runs.
